title: FINALLY! Kaspa Is Becoming Unstoppable!
description:
Kaspa now has real tokens on its base layer. KCC-20 is the shared rulebook for a fungible token built from covenants, and every transfer is enforced by the chain's own script rules, not by an off-chain indexer.

In this video I break down how KCC-20 works: the common interface, extended state, flexible authority from KCC-2, and Borrowed Receive. Then how it differs from KRC-20 from Kasplex, where your balance is the indexer's answer. And the whole timeline, from the Toccata hard fork on June 30th to KCC-1, KCC-2 and KCC-20 going Final on October 21st, 2026.

Then the bigger picture. Usage is still a tiny base, the supply is fixed, and around 96.7% of all $KAS is already mined. New demand meets very little new supply... and the high conviction holders in it for the long haul are going to make it big time.
